set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- BorrowedNDArray exposes reshapeView returning BorrowedNDArray and reshapeCopy returning owned NDArray.
- Any convenience reshape retained on borrowed input always has one truthful ownership result type.
- Empty-axis array-valued reductions never return borrowed storage typed as NDArray.
- The identity-versus-allocation rule for owned empty-axis reductions is documented and tested.
- External mutation is observable only through results typed BorrowedNDArray.
- The ownership regression matrix passes on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Make borrowed reshape and identity operations ownership-honest
